scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sky/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web "npm run dev -w @sky/shared" "npm run dev -w @sky/server" "npm run dev -w @sky/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sky/shared && npm run build -w @sky/server && npm run build -w @sky/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sky/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w @sky/shared && tsx --test packages/shared/src/contract.test.ts apps/server/src/app.test.ts
